analyst_view.overall: Early view: A relegation six-pointer between 19th and 20th. Real Sociedad II (Sanse) host Sporting first; Cádiz, who have won one of their last five league games, go to Eibar in round 14. Borja Jiménez won his debut against Ceuta but has lost both games since, so the pressure on both sides should be high by kick-off.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals. I lean a little higher: Sanse's home games have been open (2-4 against Almería, 2-3 against Granada), and Cádiz have scored in all three games under Jiménez, including a late Urko Izeta header at home to Oviedo.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.4 corners and I keep it. Sanse should have more of the ball at home, as they did against Girona, and Cádiz push hard in second halves when behind, as they did against Oviedo. Nothing suggests a big swing either way.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.4 cards. I lean higher: Sanse committed 27 fouls and received six yellows against Girona, and a bottom-of-the-table game where neither side can afford to lose should be tense from the start.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.6 shots, with 16.9 for Sanse. I lean slightly lower: Sanse took 14 shots against ten-man Girona, so nearly 17 against Cádiz looks generous, and six-pointers between nervous sides often slow down.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.2 shots on target, which fits two teams who score a fair amount but not efficiently. I hold here until both have played in round 14.
